# Netlify handoff — Klarity by Safenai

The Netlify connector was not available in the build session, so this prototype
is committed to the repo and needs a Netlify-enabled session to deploy it.

## Deploy instructions (do not edit the HTML)
- **Repo:** rifqiraka234-oss/astra-agency
- **Branch:** claude/workflow-docs-update-cxm8ih
- **File to deploy:** `state/prototypes/klarity/index.html`
  (this is the single self-contained file; all fonts and images are embedded)
- **Site name to create:** `astra-klarity-prototype`
  (→ https://astra-klarity-prototype.netlify.app)
- **Do NOT modify the HTML.** Deploy the exact file.

## Verify you have the right file before deploying
- **Bytes:** 931818
- **sha256:** 59ece01b6e7e1deefe1052fdce0351956b99f7f41360ff37529fe17e1439207d
- **`<title>`:** `Klarity by Safenai — operate your AI in production with control`

## After deploy, confirm the live URL
Fetch the live URL and check the byte size and sha256 match the values above,
and that the `<title>` matches, before anyone sends the link. Do not eyeball
"a page loaded."

## Note on .gitignore
`state/prototypes/` is `.gitignore`d, but `state/prototypes/klarity/index.html`
is force-tracked (`git add -f`), so a fresh clone contains it despite the
ignore rule.

## Do not send the link from a handoff session
Sending the live link to Julien stays with whoever is driving outreach (Raka),
not the deploy session.
